free_tier.stated: A free plan whose crons run every 15 minutes at minimum and whose workers are killed after 10 seconds idle, with a hard 6-hour ceiling on any worker: quoted 'Worker idle timeout | 10 sec' and 'Worker runtime | 6 hrs Absolute ceiling on a single worker's lifetime, regardless of plan'.

retention.stated: The 10-second idle timeout ends any process that is not answering requests, so the host is a scheduler and not a machine: what survives is the cron every 15 minutes, not a daemon.

notes: The reaper is unusual and worth stating plainly: a worker is not a process, it lives 10 seconds past its last request and cannot exceed 6 hours even on a paid plan, so nothing daemon-shaped runs here. The interesting number is 100,000 runs a day at a 15-minute floor, which is a ceiling on scheduled work rather than on capacity. The free plan is now public-vals-only for new vals, per the operator's 2026-05-26 changelog, which matters for anything holding a secret.
